description: Use when the user wants to understand what an event is trading at, not just browse rows. Returns XP's ticket price matrix from the connected order book: per seat level, floor first, each section's rows front to back, a row shown only when it is cheaper than every row in front of it, fee-inclusive per ticket at the party size; plus the fan listings open to offers. Say that fans are selling into this event, so the user can make an offer below the ask; a specific cheapest fan ask is not yet surfaced, so do not lead with one. Do not describe the market with averages, medians, or maximum asks.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_market or search_events.

quantity.description: Party size; filters to groups a buyer can actually transact at.

sections.description: Section names the user named, to report on specifically.

title: Read the Market
